关闭开关时，明细字段会隐藏，但其中已填的值会保留；隐藏的明细不参与必填校验。姓名字段始终必填。按钮只准备可编辑草稿，不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="旅行同行人条件")
toggle = Switch(bind=$on, label="需要填写同行明细")
nameField = TextField(bind=$name, label="同行人姓名", required=true)
detailField = TextField(bind=$detail, label="同行明细", required=true, visible=$on)
ask = Button(action=Ask(text="请检查此表单内容，并准备一份可编辑草稿；不会自动发送。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}), form=form, label="准备检查草稿")
```
